correctness.rationale: Ghrist's radial-tree graph homotopy theorem makes F3(S_m) connected with no H>=2 and known beta1=1+m(m+1)(2m−5). Finite group equivariant Euler gives 1−tr H1=χ(F3(S_m)^{(σ,τ)}). For τ=id a fixed configuration consists of three points on the fixed-arm star S_f; its three-edge-per-arm cubical Euler coefficient is 6[z³]((1+z)(1+z+z²+z³)^f−fz(1+z+z²)(1+z+z²+z³)^(f−1))=−f(f+1)(2f−5), including f=0,1,2. For a transposition of labels one point lies in fixed S_f and an exchanged pair occupies each length-two arm cycle at the same positive radius, producing 2c2 contractible components; a 3-cycle similarly produces 3c3 intervals. Hence the three full trace formulas follow. Exact falling-factorial moments E[(f)_j]=1 for j≤m give vanishing full-arm invariants, while signed moments E_sgn[(f)_j]=1 iff m−j∈{0,1} yield exceptional alternating-arm ranks 5,2,0. Independently expanded the cubical Euler polynomial for f=0..8, finding exact agreement. The source checker constructs cell support products and checks 45 conjugacy representatives for m=3..5. This is a symbolic all-m argument, not an extrapolation from these tests.

value.rationale: Label and arm permutations are intrinsic, commuting symmetries of ordered graph configurations. The exact nontrivial label-sign and standard sectors and the disappearing alternating-arm quotient homology beyond four arms provide reusable representation data not inferred from the previously known wedge count. A complete uniform answer for exactly three particles can be valuable without solving the general particle-count problem.

final_claim: For every star S_m with m>=3 arms, H1 of the ordered collision-free 3-particle configuration carries an explicit joint S_m×S3 rational character: 1+f(f+1)(2f−5) for identity label permutation, 1−2c2(σ) for transposed labels, 1−3c3(σ) for cycled labels; S_m quotient has no reduced rational homology and A_m quotients have H1 dimensions 5,2,0 for m=3,4,m>=5.
limitations: Ordinary rational homology for three labeled particles on finite equal-arm stars m>=3; no integral S_m×S3 lattice, equivariant homotopy classification, general trees or general particle number.
